description:
Professional 20*3.0 Fat E-Bike
HITWAY electric bicycle is specially equipped with durable 3.0 professional fat tires, which are wear-resistant and anti-puncture. Whether you're exploring mountains, city streets, or immersing yourself in nature, you can ride freely and even traverse through snow, sand, and other challenging terrains.
Experience Superb Power and Long-Distance Travel
Equipped with a powerful 750W 48V motor, the HITWAY BK6M ebike effortlessly conquers steep slopes of up to 25 degrees. With its 14Ah removable battery, you can enjoy a maximum range of 55-120km(35-75 mile) on a single charge, depending on the mode selected. If you crave excitement and adventure, this ebike is perfect for non-stop exploration.
Innovative Design Features
BK6M ebike features aluminum alloy body, high strength and net weight is 27.6kg. The foldable design is easy to carry and space-saving. There's also an easy-to-read LCD display (which shows battery, mileage, speed, error codes, etc.) and headlights and reflectors to keep you safe.We recommend optimal user between 163cm-190cm (5'4''-6'3'').
Improved Acceleration Mode
You have the option to choose from three driving modes: pure electric mode, normal mode, and assist mode. In normal bike mode, you can take advantage of the 7-speed Shimano transmission system and mechanical transmissions, offering a unique acceleration experience. In assist mode and pure electric mode, you can enjoy unexpectedly fast speeds.
Excellent Shock Absorption
The HITWAY bike is equipped with front suspension, seat shock absorbers, and high-volume low-pressure tires that act as additional shock absorbers. This combination provides superior balance and control, even on rough mountain roads. The front and rear double disc brakes, along with electronic brakes, ensure comprehensive safety during your rides.
